# claudectl

> The workspace layer for Claude Code. A terminal UI and desktop GUI that give Claude Code
> persistent per-project memory, a browsable and searchable session archive, MCP server
> awareness, an interactive architecture graph and per-project launch control. Pure Python
> standard library, zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed. Runs on Windows, macOS and
> Linux; Windows-first.

claudectl does not replace Claude Code — it configures and launches it, and maintains the
project context between sessions. It uses your existing Claude Code authentication.
Install with `pipx install claudectl`, or clone the repository and run it.

## Getting started

- [Install](https://claudectl.vercel.app/install/): requirements, pipx/pip, running from a checkout, the Claude Code plugin, GUI setup and Windows shortcuts.
- [Download](https://claudectl.vercel.app/download/): every way to get it — PyPI, the GitHub release page, the Claude Code plugin marketplace, a source checkout — what each release contains and the versioning policy.
- [Usage](https://claudectl.vercel.app/usage/): screens, full key bindings and the command line.

## Features

- [Features overview](https://claudectl.vercel.app/features/): one page per feature area.
- [Sessions and search](https://claudectl.vercel.app/sessions/): browse, search, tag, fork, resume, archive and export sessions; usage analytics; per-project launch control.
- [Project memory](https://claudectl.vercel.app/memory/): the semantic memory graph, its three token-budgeted injection surfaces, session lessons and recall.
- [Architecture graph](https://claudectl.vercel.app/graph/): the interactive, expandable dependency graph rendered as self-contained HTML.
- [Plan to Execute and OmniRoute](https://claudectl.vercel.app/plan-execute/): plan on an accurate model, execute on a cheap or free one; OmniRoute setup and troubleshooting.
- [Multiple accounts](https://claudectl.vercel.app/accounts/): running two or more Claude accounts, per-launch account selection, cross-account context injection.
- [Context hand-off](https://claudectl.vercel.app/context-handoff/): starting a new session seeded with a previous session's transcript, optionally under a different account — for when the context window fills up or an account hits its rate limit.
- [MCP servers](https://claudectl.vercel.app/mcp/): add, remove and inspect MCP servers; connection state; tool documentation.
- [Agents and skills](https://claudectl.vercel.app/agents/): the agent library, per-project subagent selection, adaptive suggestions, the skills manager.
- [Hooks](https://claudectl.vercel.app/hooks/): 19 Claude Code hook templates plus AI-generated hooks.
- [Status line, failover and checkpoints](https://claudectl.vercel.app/statusline/): the per-turn status line, the model failover proxy, the read-only checkpoint view.
- [Desktop GUI](https://claudectl.vercel.app/gui/): the local web GUI, its shells, and the 29 palettes / 7 skins / 4 worlds theme system.

## Guides

- [Token economy](https://claudectl.vercel.app/token-economy/): how it reduces per-message context cost — bounded index, path-scoped rules, task-scoped injection, context weight audit, deny rules, economy model routing.
- [Project health and auto-fixes](https://claudectl.vercel.app/health/): pre-launch health card, context-loss insurance, permission-fatigue killer.
- [Installing the agent library](https://claudectl.vercel.app/agent-library/): bulk-installing the awesome-claude-code-subagents catalog.

## Reference

- [Files, layout and encoding](https://claudectl.vercel.app/reference/): per-project files, workspace status, CLAUDE.md auto-generation, session encoding, file layout.
- [API reference](https://claudectl.vercel.app/api/): the local HTTP API the desktop GUI is built on, generated from the route tables.
